description: This file defines a PHP class PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI which is an API endpoint for managing final evaluations of performance reviews, including finalizing reviews and retrieving review details within an HR management system.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for final evaluation operations of performance reviews, including finalizing reviews and fetching review details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Finalizes a performance review or updates its evaluation data based on request parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a completed or in-progress performance review by its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete operation is not implemented for this API.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a performance review evaluation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific performance review.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns not implemented exception for delete validation.

methods.name: setFinalEvaluation
methods.description: Sets final evaluation attributes (rating, comment, date, status) on a PerformanceReview object based on request parameters.
